description: What a host or service carries, before you disable, delete or take it out of the monitoring: its services, the hosts that depend on it, and the groups, maps and reports that name it. Use it to say what a change would affect.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

servicename.description: Exact service name on that host. Empty: the host itself.

name: get_impact
title: Impact
